Dear Fjord Components AS,

Thank you for your quotation of 0.79 USD per unit with an 18-day lead time for 10,000 M8 stainless hex bolts.

We are working within a constrained budget for this project. Would you be able to offer a unit price of 0.73 USD and a lead time of 16 days? This would help us move forward with the order.

We value your partnership and look forward to your response.

Best regards,
ProcureAI Demo Buyer
